message: fix(hud): use container layout to prevent XP and objective overlap
purpose: The added native HUD regression correctly detected the XP row making the vitals panel overlap the fixed-position objective tracker. Put both existing panels in a shared vertical container with explicit separation. Preserve original global starting position, widget identities, mouse filtering and all assertions. The fix responds to the measured layout failure rather than weakening the test.

replacements.old:
var vitals = new HudPanel { Name = "Vitals", Position = new Vector2(16, 16), CustomMinimumSize = new Vector2(286, 0) };
        hud.AddChild(vitals);

var objectives = new HudPanel { Name = "QuestTracker", Position = new Vector2(16, 195), CustomMinimumSize = new Vector2(286, 0) };
        hud.AddChild(objectives);
